OS for which CAM is being built. The default value is the name contained in Perl's $OSNAME variable. This parameter allows the user to override that setting to allow for cross-compilation, and for instances where the $OSNAME value is too generic. For example, currently on both cray-xt and bluegene systems $OSNAME has the value "linux".
